answer: An agent economy can quarantine Sybils by reading the shape of its trade graph. Honest agents deal with many unrelated partners, while a fake cluster hangs off the core by only a thin thread of links. The network measures the narrowest cut around each cluster; groups behind a thin bottleneck are quarantined until they build many independent links. A beacon registry publishes each cluster's cut width, and ferrous proof of trades weights every edge. One operator's spiral of sock-puppets cannot fake dozens of real counterparties: escaping quarantine means funding a web of genuine commerce.
